question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** In**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3 is **In.**
 
• We shall utilise the preposition **IN** to refer to **towns, cities, countries, or continents.**
 
• Thus the correct proposition will be **In.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Upon- **The preposition **"upon"** is used when** something is on another.** Well, there are several aspects to use **Upon** in the sentences.
 
• **On - **In English, the preposition **"on"** has numerous functions. In **time expressions with specific days of the week,** the word **"on"** is used. **On** is used for both **large and tiny flat surfaces**.
 
• **At - **One of the most widely used prepositions in English is **"at."** **Specific periods of the day** are associated with the preposition **"at." **When referring to **specific areas in cities **or **the countryside,** the preposition "at" is used. When referring to** locations in a city as buildings**, the preposition "at" is used.
